num_series AS (

customer_date_range AS (

           MIN(txn_date)::DATE as min_date,
           MAX(txn_date)::DATE as max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_dates AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, a.txn_date
    FROM customer_date_range c
    CROSS JOIN all_dates a
    WHERE a.txn_date >= c.min_date AND a.txn_date <= c.max_date
),
daily_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type IN ('purchase', 'withdrawal') THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) as daily_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
all_balances AS (
    SELECT cd.customer_id, cd.txn_date, COALESCE(n.daily_net, 0) as daily_net
    FROM customer_dates cd
    LEFT JOIN daily_net n ON cd.customer_id = n.customer_id AND cd.txn_date = n.txn_date
),
numbered AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, daily_net,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as rn
    FROM all_balances
),
recursive_bal AS (
    -- Base case: first day for each customer
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, daily_net, rn,
           GREATEST(daily_net, 0) as balance
    FROM numbered
    WHERE rn = 1
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive case
    SELECT n.customer_id, n.txn_date, n.daily_net, n.rn,
           GREATEST(rb.balance + n.daily_net, 0)
    FROM recursive_bal rb
    JOIN numbered n ON rb.customer_id = n.customer_id AND n.rn = rb.rn + 1
)
SELECT customer_id, txn_date, balance
FROM recursive_bal
WHERE customer_id = 429
ORDER BY txn_date
